text.formatted: The drider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
text.plain: The drider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

text.formatted: While in sunlight, the drider has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
text.plain: While in sunlight, the drider has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

text.formatted: The drider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the drider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
text.plain: The drider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the drider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

text.formatted: The drider makes three attacks, using Foreleg or Poison Burst in any combination.
text.plain: The drider makes three attacks, using Foreleg or Poison Burst in any combination.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +7, reach 10 ft. _Hit:_ 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage.

text.formatted: _Ranged Attack Roll:_ +6, range 120 ft. _Hit:_ 13 (3d6 + 3) Poison damage.
text.plain: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 120 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Poison damage.

text.formatted: The drider casts Darkness, Faerie Fire, or Web, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14).
text.plain: The drider casts Darkness, Faerie Fire, or Web, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14).
